snippets.code:
# Import a registered CSV with explicit types and missing-value codes.
data <- readr::read_delim("<bound-path>.csv", delim = ",",
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()),
  na = c("", "NA"), locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
readr::problems(data)

# Keep only mapped roles and make exclusions explicit.
roles <- data[c("<outcome>", "<predictor>")]
complete <- stats::complete.cases(roles)
roles <- dplyr::filter(roles, complete)

# Descriptive table without inferential tests.
no_test <- list(name = "Descriptive only - no inference", abbreviation = "none",
  p = function(...) NA_real_)
table <- DescrTab2::descr(data[c("<variable-1>", "<variable-2>")],
  test_options = list(test_override = no_test),
  format_options = list(print_p = FALSE, print_CI = FALSE))

# Descriptive-only summary in base R.
x <- data[["<numeric-variable>"]]
c(n = sum(!is.na(x)), missing = sum(is.na(x)), mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd = stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))

# Accessible scatter: colour-blind-flagged Brewer palette plus shapes.
colours <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(3, "Dark2")
plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[["<x>"]], y = .data[["<y>"]],
    colour = .data[["<group>"]], shape = .data[["<group>"]])) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() + ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = colours)
patchwork::wrap_plots(list(plot)) + patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

# Linear model on aliased columns (response, x1, ...); never paste user names into formulas.
fit <- stats::lm(response ~ x1, data = tidy_data, na.action = stats::na.fail)
stats::coef(fit)
broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)

# Logistic regression; response coded 1 = event, 0 = non-event.
fit <- stats::glm(response ~ x1, data = tidy_data, family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"),
  na.action = stats::na.fail)
broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)

# Random-intercept mixed model; subject identifies the repeated unit.
fit <- nlme::lme(response ~ x1, data = tidy_data, random = ~ 1 | subject, method = "REML",
  na.action = stats::na.fail)
nlme::fixef(fit)
nlme::getVarCov(fit)

# Cox model for right-censored data; event coded 1 = event, 0 = censored.
fit <- survival::coxph(survival::Surv(time, event) ~ x1, data = tidy_data, ties = "efron",
  na.action = stats::na.fail)
survival::cox.zph(fit)

# Tidy estimates with confidence intervals for a fitted model.
broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE)

# Render the project pages explicitly from the project root.
rmarkdown::render_site("analysis")
